architecture.text: Long-context attention inefficiencies and world model consistency are being resolved through hyperbolic geometry, GTR gated token recurrence, HySparse2 two-level KV sharing, and WorldCrafter implicit 3D-aware memory.

new-models.text: New open-weights models like Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro and architectures such as MintAct, OmniVChat, and flow-based generative models are driving advances in audio-visual dialogue, vision agents, and materials discovery.

inference-methods.text: Practitioners are scaling test-time compute through search policies, applying on-policy distillation to sub-3-bit models, disaggregating prefill-decode quantization, and compressing context via CompKV and state management.

inference-engines.text: Recent work optimizes large scale AI serving and training using Flux, SARA, NVIDIA Topograph, DHSched, and vLLM to manage memory tiering, topology awareness, and agentic inference.

silicon.text: Engineers are optimizing TPU v6e and FPGA hardware, managing GPU cluster power surges, and scaling AI via DRAM/SSD offloading, optical interconnects, and dynamic clocking.

training.text: RL alignment and reward hacking dominate training, featuring group relative policy optimization, instance-aware rubric rewards, and agentic reinforcement learning for video and code generation.

economics.text: Self-hosted open-weight inference economics and structural token cost reductions are driving broad-market price cuts of forty to fifty percent across AI systems.
